content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%'", "explanation": "按名称关键字匹配中心厂，直接取 plant 表中的设计处理规模字段。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站，返回名称、类型和设计规模。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选厂站类型为集镇厂，按设计规模降序取第一条即为最大的集镇厂。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选鼓风机，统计总数及状态为备用的数量。"}
{"sql": "SELECT sum(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_m3_d, count(*) AS 厂站数 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计规模求和。"}
{"sql": "SELECT d.kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(d.rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device d GROUP BY d.kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC", "explanation": "按 device.kind 分组统计设备台数与额定功率合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称关键字匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出编码、类型等信息。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型, d.model AS 型号, round(d.rated_kw::numeric, 1) AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC NULLS LAST, d.code LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按额定功率降序排列设备台账，取功率最大的前 10 台，并关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从实时表 plant_reading 取中心厂（P01）最新一条记录的进水瞬时流量作为当前值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取最近30分钟内每个厂站最新一条实时数据，按厂站去重后展示好氧区溶解氧。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 1) AS 污泥浓度MLSS
FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL AND r.ts > now() - interval '2 hours'
ORDER BY r.ts DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取协税镇污水站最近2小时内最新一条含 MLSS 的实时监测记录，展示当前污泥浓度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按设备编码 P01-BL-1（中心厂1号鼓风机）取最近半小时内最新一条运行监测数据，返回当前电流。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天（前一个自然日）全区所有厂站小时表的进水量即处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, r.tn_out AS 出水总氮
  FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
  WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
  ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC
)
SELECT 厂站, 时间, round(出水总氮::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL
FROM latest ORDER BY 出水总氮 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取各厂最近30分钟内的最新一条实时数据中的出水总氮，按总氮降序取第一名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name, p.id ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站汇总本周（自本周一零点起）小时表的进水流量，即各厂处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天整天的 1 小时均值数据，鼓风机功率按小时求和即得耗电量（度）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "查询 plant_reading_1h 中最近24小时各厂 nh3n_in 的小时均值再取平均，按厂站分组展示。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD均值_mgL, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "用小时均值表筛选中心厂今天 0—12 点（上午）的数据，对进水 COD 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD均值, round(avg(h.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选厂站名称含“中心”的厂站，取昨天整日（00:00 至今日 00:00）的小时均值数据，对出水 COD、氨氮、总氮、总磷求日均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "统计昨天（前一自然日）全部厂站小时表的鼓风机耗电量与处理水量之和，并相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now()", "explanation": "汇总本周（周一起至当前）所有厂站小时表的碳源与PAC投加量，分别求和得到全区总量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温_摄氏度, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温_摄氏度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())","explanation":"统计昨天自然日气象数据中的最高和最低气温。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / 6)::numeric, 0) AS 平均日处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '6 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now());","explanation":"筛选梁山镇污水站10月30日至11月4日共6天的小时处理水量，求和后除以6得到平均日处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, round(min(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 最低_mgL, round(max(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 最高_mgL, count(*) AS 采样点数 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "小时均值表 plant_reading_1h 无 MLSS 字段，故用原始表 plant_reading 统计最近7天各厂 MLSS 的均值、极值与样本数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= timestamp '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08'
  AND h.hour < timestamp '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'
ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按 2026-11-03 全天筛选协税镇污水站的小时聚合数据，输出每小时出水总磷均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h, count(*) AS 小时数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "按小时聚合表取 P01 中心厂昨天全天各小时平均曝气风量，再求全日平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY h.hour
ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按小时分组汇总全区所有厂站今天的处理水量（sum(inflow_m3h)），时间范围为今天 0 点至今。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_摄氏度 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01' AND ts < '2026-11-05' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按自然日对气象数据的气温取平均，统计 11 月 1 日至 4 日每天的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT (date_trunc('day', h.hour))::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 曝气耗电量_kWh, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "筛选中心厂本周的小时数据，按自然日汇总处理水量与鼓风机耗电量，计算每日吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1","explanation":"统计过去7天各厂站小时均值数据的出水COD平均值，并按平均值降序取最高的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按厂站汇总昨天全天的小时处理水量，降序取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 6) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_per_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "取过去7天各厂碳源投加总量除以处理水量总量，得到吨水碳源投加量并降序排列。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在最近7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取第一条，得到最高的厂站、整点时间和浓度值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3, count(DISTINCT h.plant_id) AS 厂站数 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按自然日汇总最近7个完整日全区各厂站小时处理水量，取总量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY p.name HAVING sum(h.inflow_m3h) > 0 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "统计本周各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量之比（吨水曝气电耗），按升序取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id","explanation":"查询过去7天内出水氨氮小时最大值超过一级A标准5 mg/L的厂站，并统计超标小时数和最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.tp_out_max > 0.5) AS 总磷超标小时数, count(DISTINCT p.id) FILTER (WHERE h.tp_out_max > 0.5) AS 涉及厂站数, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now()", "explanation": "统计本周以来全区所有厂站小时均值中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时数，并给出涉及厂站数与最高值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮平均值_mgL, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮最大小时均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name","explanation":"查询中心厂过去7天的小时均值数据，计算出水总氮的平均值和最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站,
       count(h.hour) AS 有数据小时数,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15
                          OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数
FROM plant p
LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h
       ON h.plant_id = p.id
      AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
      AND h.hour <  date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "以 plant 为主表左连接昨天的小时数据，按一级A标准统计各厂出水任一项超标的小时数，无超标或无数据的厂也会列出（计为 0）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 首次超标时间, round(h.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷_mg_L FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5 ORDER BY h.hour ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在本周范围内筛选协税镇小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 的记录，按时间升序取第一条即为首次超标时刻。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 氨氮最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇污水站昨天（11月4日）的小时数据，按小时出水氨氮最大值统计超标小时数并取当日最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, round(max(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s, round(avg(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 平均振动_mm_s, count(*) AS 监测条数 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name, d.code ORDER BY max(r.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计最近7天各鼓风机振动最大值，按最大值降序取第一台。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "从设备台账筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表返回所属厂站名称及设备信息。"}

{"sql":"SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_摄氏度
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.code = 'P01'
  AND d.kind = '鼓风机'
  AND r.running = true
  AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY d.code
ORDER BY d.code","explanation":"筛选中心厂鼓风机过去24小时内运行时的监测记录，按设备计算平均轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流_A
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.name = '南郑中心污水处理厂'
  AND d.kind = '提升泵'
  AND r.running
  AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY d.code
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵昨天的运行记录，按设备编码求平均电流。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 停机分钟数
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1'
  AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
  AND r.running IS FALSE", "explanation": "统计黄官镇1号鼓风机在昨天（11月4日）全天运行状态为停机的每分钟记录数，即停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS 时间, round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h
FROM weather
WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选 2026 年 10 月 31 日全天气象数据，按小时聚合后取降雨强度最大值及出现时间，即当日暴雨峰值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.running) AS 运行分钟 FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, d.id, d.code ORDER BY p.id, d.code","explanation":"筛选昨天各厂污泥泵的分钟级设备数据，按厂站和污泥泵设备统计 running 为真的记录数，即运行分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨开始时间, to_char(max(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS 降雨结束时间, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 累计降雨量_mm, count(*) AS 有效记录数 FROM weather WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h > 0", "explanation": "筛选 10 月 31 日全天降雨强度大于 0 的记录，取最早和最晚时间作为降雨起止时间，并汇总累计降雨量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT r.ts AS 时间, round(r.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.code LIKE '%-BL-1' AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) ORDER BY r.ts ASC LIMIT 1","explanation":"筛选黄官镇污水站1号鼓风机在11月4日振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最高值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选协税镇 11 月 3 日全天的小时数据，取小时出水总磷最大值 tp_out_max 的最大值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric) AS \"10月31日处理水量_m3\", round(sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric) AS \"10月30日处理水量_m3\", round((sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END))::numeric) AS \"比前一天增加_m3\" FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name","explanation":"汇总梁山镇污水站10月30日和10月31日的小时处理水量，并计算10月31日较前一日增加量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(min(r.do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 3) AS 好氧区1号最低DO, round(min(r.do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 3) AS 好氧区2号最低DO, round(min(least(r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2))::numeric, 3) AS 好氧区最低DO, count(*) AS 样本数
FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%'
  AND r.ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08'
  AND r.ts <  timestamptz '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08'", "explanation": "按原始分钟级数据筛选黄官镇污水厂 11月4日15:00-18:00 的溶解氧，取好氧区1号、2号及两者的最小值作为故障期间最低DO。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round((sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END))::numeric) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((sum(CASE WHEN h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END))::numeric) AS 前日处理水量_m3, round((sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE -h.inflow_m3h END))::numeric) AS 增加量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "分别汇总昨天与前天全区小时处理水量，并计算两者差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - avg(h.tn_out) / avg(h.tn_in))::numeric * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "用 plant_reading_1h 统计最近 7 天各厂进出水总氮均值，按 (1-出水/进水) 计算总氮去除率。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂')::numeric, 1) AS 中心厂处理水量_m3,
       round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 全区处理水量_m3,
       round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 占比_百分比
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂小时处理水量之和，用 FILTER 取出中心厂水量并除以全区总水量得到百分比。"}

{"sql":"WITH rain_day AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, max(rain_mm_h) AS 最大降雨强度
  FROM weather
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY 最大降雨强度 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT r.日期 AS 日期,
       round(r.最大降雨强度::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h,
       round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 全区处理水量_m3
FROM rain_day r
LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h
  ON date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date = r.日期
GROUP BY r.日期, r.最大降雨强度
ORDER BY r.日期","explanation":"先找出过去7天内日最大降雨强度最高的一天，再汇总该日全区各厂站的小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH plant_avg AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name), district_avg AS (SELECT avg(cod_in) AS avg_cod FROM plant_reading_1h WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days') SELECT pa.name AS 厂站, round(pa.avg_cod::numeric, 1) AS 平均进水COD, round((SELECT avg_cod FROM district_avg)::numeric, 1) AS 全区平均进水COD FROM plant_avg pa WHERE pa.avg_cod > (SELECT avg_cod FROM district_avg) ORDER BY pa.avg_cod DESC", "explanation": "按厂站统计过去7天小时均值进水COD，并与同期全区平均进水COD比较，筛选高于全区平均的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "汇总昨天各厂小时处理水量（即 inflow_m3h 之和），除以设计规模得到负荷率百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS 工艺, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3, count(DISTINCT p.id) AS 厂站数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) AND p.process IN ('A2O','氧化沟') GROUP BY p.process ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC", "explanation": "按工艺分组汇总昨天（前一自然日）小时表处理水量，仅统计 A2O 与氧化沟工艺厂站。"}
